turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Marcus! Happy Monday. How is everything starting off for you today in Portland?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Monday is off to a pretty fast start, honestly. I had to rush a bit this morning, so I just whipped up a quick protein smoothie for breakfast before heading out.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A protein smoothie is a great way to fuel up fast. Is it a busy week ahead at the high school, or are things relatively quiet in the science department right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's definitely busy. We're prepping for upcoming exams and wrapping up some lab assessments, so my desk is piled high. But I did manage to carve out some time for a workout today and did some gym weights.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Good for you for fitting that in! Getting some gym weights in must be a nice break from all the lesson prep. How is Olive doing? Is she still keeping you company when you're grading papers at home?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, absolutely. Olive is currently obsessed with sitting right on my lesson plan binder the second I open it. Grace has to distract her with a toy sometimes so I can actually read what I wrote.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Haha, typical cat behavior! She just wants to be involved in the science department. Have you and Grace been able to get any tennis in lately with the spring weather?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not as much as we'd like, but we're hoping to play a couple of sets this coming weekend if the weather holds up. Portland springs can be so unpredictable.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: They definitely can be. Oh, by the way, how is your neighbor's vegetable garden coming along? Have you noticed any progress over the fence?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, yes! I saw them out there yesterday. They've got some neat little rows of green sprouts coming up now. Seeing it is making me want to head out to my workshop and do some woodworking to build a few outdoor planter boxes.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a perfect project! You'll have to let me know if you end up starting on those planter boxes. I hope the rest of your Monday goes smoothly with the prep work.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I appreciate it. I'll talk to you later!
